title: The War God Possesses the Chief - Then Ada Snaps
description: Mars takes over Wad's body to turn the tribe into cannibals, but a slave girl decides she's had enough. The cave that's supposed to be safe has other plans.
hook_note: Picking up on the invisible war god landing means we open mid-possession, the exact beat the last short teased.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: So this washed-up war god just landed among Wad's tribe, and he's spotted his ride: big man Wad himself.

segments.text: So this washed-up war god just landed among Wad's tribe, and he's spotted his ride: big man Wad himself.

shots.speaker: Mars
shots.line: This is my chance to destroy a civilization... I'll enter Wad's body!

shots.speaker: Wad
shots.line: HOW DARE A STRANGER INTERFERE WITH MY PEOPLE?... TAKE THIS!

segments.text: How dare a stranger interfere with my people?... Take this!
Earthman's fist!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: One good punch, and then the whole village piles on our boy Dick. One fist versus a mob was never the move.

shots.speaker: Wad
shots.line: TONIGHT WE FEAST ON YOUR TENDER EARTH-MAN'S FLESH! TOMORROW WE INVADE THE HIDDEN PEOPLE!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Cannibals, apparently. But Ada, the girl who's been a slave this whole time? She's carrying this entire comic on her back.

shots.line: I HAVE BEEN A SLAVE TOO LONG! DIE!..

shots.line: They will follow us! I overheard the hunter tell where the hidden people dwell. We will go there and warn them!

shots.line: They make the cave, they stop to breathe, and they completely fail to notice the face watching them from the rocks.

We're trapped!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Hundreds of tiny creatures swarm them, drag them off, and haul them straight to a queen. And that's a problem for another day.

cliffhanger_note: Dick and Ada are captured by the dwarf-people and dragged before their queen, with Wad still hunting them and a war god riding along.
